# Claude Code Security Reviewer

> {BLOCKQUOTE}

{DESCRIPTION}

## Source Modules

- [claudecode.claude_api_client](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/claude_api_client.py): Client for calling Claude API directly for security analysis tasks.
- [claudecode.evals.eval_engine](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/evals/eval_engine.py): Single evaluation test case.
- [claudecode.evals.run_eval](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/evals/run_eval.py): Single evaluation test case.
- [claudecode.findings_filter](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/findings_filter.py): Statistics about the filtering process.
- [claudecode.github_action_audit](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/github_action_audit.py): Raised when configuration is invalid or missing.
- [claudecode.json_parser](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/json_parser.py): Extract JSON object from text, looking in various formats and locations.
- [claudecode.logger](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/logger.py): Get a configured logger that outputs to stderr.
- [claudecode.prompts](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/prompts.py): Generate security audit prompt for Claude Code.
